summary: Sync the template payload to the refined release ceremony by adding the Next Release issue template, milestone-aware enforcement workflows, and fragment-first payload guidance.
migration_impact: New PLATE repositories created from the template now inherit the standing Next Release template, milestone-based Epic/Release enforcement, Development-sidebar-compatible PR issue linking, and fragment-first release-note guidance.
migration_guidance: 1. Pull the updated template payload files together so release issue templates, enforcement workflows, and process docs all use the same milestone-based release ceremony.

2. Add the payload `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/release.yml` alongside the updated inventory so downstream repositories bootstrap a standing `Next Release` issue instead of relying on manual reconstruction.
3. If you previously relied on `Epic: short-name` labels as the only Epic container, start assigning Epic milestones and keep PR milestones aligned during the warning-first rollout.
agent_notes: Do not sync the root repository CI or Copilot instructions wholesale into the payload; those files are intentionally different because the payload is a downstream template, not the self-hosting `plate` repo.
